comparison.objective: Capture a reference angle with a bevel gauge, transfer it to a board, and draw the corresponding line.
comparison.physical_skill: Fit and preserve a passive hinge angle during transport, seat the gauge, and guide a marker accurately.
comparison.success_condition: Valid retained angle transfer plus a single line meeting coverage, angle, gap, stray-mark, and final-clearance thresholds.
comparison.reason: Angle capture and guided marking test metrology and tool use, not controlled many-body separation through physical apertures. No material rubric details are missing.
